set.name: Moradi real-content set (one house) — VQ 1.2 complete exemplar

in_motion.basis: VQ 1.2 content generation (~521-530k anisotropic splats) on the locked Spark 2.4.0 renderer — experimental, R&D-only

eql_2_blockers: no metric node positions (Kuula publishes no capture positions)

movement_envelope.source: set-wide @0.75 m battery (this scene included) + full distance ladders on moradi_bed1a (mx/px) and moradi_main3 (pz) anchor the curve (PRIME 0.2-0.6 / ACCEPTED 0.75 / TRANSIT 1.0-1.3 m)
movement_envelope.measurement_method: distance ladder 0.2->1.3 m with settle-aware captures; VLM confirmation on the 3 riskiest rooms
movement_envelope.note: harness default clamp now equals this measured value (was 1.3 = TRANSIT edge)
